page.layout: One page of title text, all lines centred, with a woodcut roundel below the text and the imprint at the foot. No running head, page number or catchword.

main_text.l: spatio ad nostri ævi usum accommodatis,

page.notes: Engraving: a circular woodcut roundel between the title and the imprint, with the legend "OMNIA EX UNO" around its border. Inside is a seated female figure holding up an object, with a building or landscape behind her. Handwritten "R" in the left margin, a library stamp at the foot and show-through are not transcribed. Printed as in the scan: "Marpvrgici" with v for u, "imperandum," with a trailing comma, and "Idéa" with an accent.
